description: False-colour infrared satellite imagery, acquired by Spot 5 on 2011-05-06 using a 1/2/3 band combination, depicts an area classified as "Dry natural grassland without woody plants (4.2.1.2)" situated on a former military training site. A bright green irregular polygon outlines the perimeter of this grassland area. Inside the outlined region, the land exhibits a non-homogenous texture with areas of greenish and reddish-brown hues, indicative of xeric grassland, sandy patches, low bushes, and heath, consistent with descriptions for grasslands in military camps. A small, bright green diamond marker is centrally located within the outlined grassland. The surrounding landscape, outside the green boundary, appears as a more uniform dark reddish-brown, suggesting different land cover types. The imagery is copyrighted by CNES 2012© and distributed by Airbus DS/Spot Image, with a spatial resolution of 2.5 metres.
